digest.component_or_area: store marker management and gitignore convergence
propositions: 119 */.archived and 126 */.write.lock files are tracked in the tickets branch HEAD despite .gitignore patterns, causing dirty git status and breaking tracker_head_sha strict head check in plan-review attestations

runtime markers (*/.archived, */.write.lock) are derived local caches with source-of-truth in ARCHIVED events and transient fcntl handles respectively, so tracking them is unnecessary and causes reconverge failures
an ensure unit untrack-runtime-markers must idempotently check git ls-files output and remove tracked markers via batched git rm --cached with a single commit
the marker reader must self-heal by re-materializing missing .archived markers for archived tickets via reducer.marker.write_marker when excluded from default list output
peers receiving the untrack commit will have their worktree marker copies deleted by the merge with clean git status, and subsequent list operations restore markers for archived tickets
